-Automation and Internet of Things innovative solutions.

positions.title: Lead iOS Developer
positions.description:
-Mobile team supervision.
-Developed an on-demand mobile iOS application in Swift from scratch. The app included
a chat, geolocation, coredata management, animations, etc.
-Infrastructure activities such as: docker container and proxy servers management, backend
deployments, etc.
-UX/UI collaboration.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
- Developing in Objective-C and Swift.
- Testing mobile applications.
- Agile development with scrum.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Obtaining, cleaning, and maintaining Big Data using Apache Spark and Hadoop.
- Plotting data using Python libraries scikit-learn and NumPy.
- Using .ipynb by running the spark-kernel.

positions.title: Professor (as a part of a Scholarship of Teaching)

positions.title: Project Engineer (P1)
positions.description:
-Elaboración de listas de cables, ductos y terminaciones. 
-Cálculo de conductores (por ampacidad y por caída de tensión).
-Diseño de bancadas.
-Dimensionamiento de centros de control de motores (CCM). 
-Rutas de canalizaciones eléctricas subterráneas y a la vista. Incluyendo detalles. 
-Sistemas de iluminación planta y detalles. 
-Disposición de equipos eléctricos. 
-Plantas de puesta a tierra y detalles.
